purpose: Read-only diagnosis of the unexplained gap between 2400 enemy callbacks and 49 observed perimeter positions.
success_marker: Observe at least 300 enemy_tick_impl and 300 perimeter_timer_tick entries, verify sampled physical and logical direct-page bytes match under PAR0=$38 and DP=0, and count any enemy_release_impl and reset_enemy_state entries.
timeout_meaning: Fewer than 300 of either entry class, missing markers, process exit, or mismatched state means incomplete diagnostic evidence; it does not establish route unreachability, a speed result, or an acceptance failure.
